role: Traffic Engineering Director, American Automobile Association
stance_basis: letter read into record stating AAA finds airport connection in interest of motoring public
summary: W. L. Marvin, Traffic Engineering Director for the American Automobile Association, submitted a letter in support of the Airport Spur project at the March 25, 1969 public hearing. He expressed that Wisconsin's AAA views the airport connection as being in the interest of the motoring public and as an important link between air and highway transportation modes. No response was deemed necessary by the Wisconsin Department of Transportation.
complaint_summary: W. L. Marvin's letter was read into the record stating that Wisconsin's AAA finds the airport connection is in the interest of the motoring public and is an important link between air and highway transportation modes.
summary_quote: Wisconsin's AAA finds the airport connection is in the interest of the motoring public and is an important link between two modes of transportation (air and highway).
